output.action: Tyler tells the coordinator he can't stay because he has his first phlebotomy class at 8 a.m.
output.explanation: Tyler has twice rearranged his overnight shifts specifically to keep the phlebotomy schedule open, and he has been looking forward to this first class all week. The coordinator's call reminds him of those rearrangements, and his desire to follow through on something real outweighs the immediate request to cover the daytime shift.
